what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Switzerland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4565 Somali refugees in Switzerland, 0.5% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1989 to 2025, at war level in most of the years since 2006, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 109 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 4814, at the end of 2000.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1997 and 1999 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Switzerland.
These are year-end totals for Switzerland only, reported to UNHCR.
